name: UkoreReferenceEditor
description: Maya-side tool that redirects broken references/textures built around the old absolute-path convention onto UkoreHub's current per-repo layout, and tracks/updates outdated Maya file references against the studio's vXXX publish-version folders. Contributes its maya-scripts folder (plus UkoreHub's own app root) to the Maya Launcher env bridge — does not launch Maya itself and has no UI of its own inside UkoreHub.
